Question: Which referred topics have the most incoming links?

SELECT t.id, t.title, COUNT(*) AS incoming_link_count FROM incoming_links il JOIN posts p ON p.id=il.post_id JOIN topics t ON t.id=p.topic_id WHERE t.deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY t.id, t.title ORDER BY incoming_link_count DESC, t.id LIMIT 20;

Question: Which external domains send the most traffic?

SELECT id.name AS domain, COUNT(*) AS incoming_link_count FROM incoming_links il JOIN incoming_referers ir ON ir.id=il.incoming_referer_id JOIN incoming_domains id ON id.id=ir.incoming_domain_id GROUP BY id.name ORDER BY incoming_link_count DESC, id.name LIMIT 20;
